title: Human and LLM Biases in Hate Speech Annotations: A Socio-Demographic Analysis of Annotators and Targets
reasoning: The paper includes religion as one of the primary socio-demographic attributes used to evaluate bias in both human and LLM annotations. It specifically analyzes how religious identity (e.g., Mormon, Christian, Muslim, Atheist, etc.) of both the annotator and the target influences the classification of hate speech.
